declarations.description:
One row of `c2-chip`s or `c2-badge`s that never wraps: the items that do not fit collapse into a `+N` indicator at
the end. The group does not measure its children. Each chip and badge reports its own size to the group it sits in,
and the group adds those sizes up against its own width to decide how many items it can show, so the row adapts
when the group is resized, an item's label changes or items are added and removed. `max` caps the count regardless
of space. With `expandable` the indicator is a button that reveals every item (the row then wraps) and a second
button collapses it again.

Give the group a width (it is a block, so it fills its container; in a flex row set `flex: 1` and `min-width: 0`).
Collapsed items stay in the DOM but are invisible and out of the accessibility tree; the indicator's label
(`3 more`) announces them, and `hiddenItems` lists them for a tooltip or a popover.
declarations.name: ChipGroup

cssProperties.description: Space between items, included in the fit calculation.
cssProperties.name: --c2-chip-group--gap

cssProperties.description: Hover border of an `expandable` indicator and of the collapse button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-chip-group__overflow__hover--border

cssParts.description: The flex row holding the visible items and the indicator.
cssParts.name: row

cssParts.description: The button that collapses an expanded group.
cssParts.name: collapse

slots.description: The items: `c2-chip`, `c2-badge`, or any element using `GroupItemSizeController` from `@c2n/core`. Other elements are measured by the group itself.

members.name: max
members.description: Most items to show, whatever the space. Unset shows as many as fit.

members.name: expanded
members.description: Shows every item, wrapping onto more rows.

members.name: expandable
members.description: Makes the indicator a button that expands the group, and adds a button that collapses it.

members.name: moreLabel
members.description: Word after the count in the indicator's accessible name: `3 more`.

members.name: collapseLabel
members.description: Text of the button that collapses an expanded group.

members.name: resizeObserver
members.description: Measures the row and the indicator, plus any child that does not report its own size.

members.name: hiddenItems
members.description: The items currently collapsed into the indicator, in document order.

members.name: fit
members.description: Decides how many items fit: all of them, or as many as fit next to the indicator.

members.name: assignNamedSlots
members.description:
A declarative shadow root (server rendering) is always in named mode, where `assign()` has no effect: route the
collapsed items by `slot` attribute instead, touching only the attribute this group wrote.

events.name: overflow-change
events.description: The number of collapsed items changed. `detail` has `visibleCount` and `hiddenCount`.

events.name: expanded-change
events.description: The user expanded or collapsed an `expandable` group. Read `expanded` on the target.
